learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to jump, run, and play! We are learning about doing words and their helpful little friends.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Verbs are doing words! Any action you can do is a verb. Sleeping, eating, dancing, and reading are all fun action verbs.
Sometimes action words need a helper! Am always helps I. Is helps one person (He/She/It). Are helps many people (We/You/They). We say I am reading or They are playing.
When an action is already finished, we use past helpers! Was is for one person, and Were is for many. For example, The cat was sleeping or The dogs were barking.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Verb Simon Says!
fun_activity.instructions: Play a game of Simon Says using only action verbs! Have a parent say Simon says jump, Simon says clap, or Simon says freeze. If they do not say Simon says, do not do the verb!

quick_recap: ⭐ Verbs are action words that tell us what someone is doing.
⭐ Is, Am, and Are help us talk about actions happening right now.
⭐ Was and Were help us talk about actions that already happened.
